name: omi_record_seal_backlog
description: Bounded sampled unsealed record backlog; lower bound when discovery saturates. No identifiers.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name="sweeper" AND jsonPayload.logger="record-seal-sweeper" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"event\": \"record_seal_sweep\"" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"outcome\": \"ok\""

name: omi_record_seal_oldest_unsealed_seconds
description: Oldest observed unsealed record age in seconds; lower bound when discovery saturates. No identifiers.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name="sweeper" AND jsonPayload.logger="record-seal-sweeper" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"event\": \"record_seal_sweep\"" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"outcome\": \"ok\""

name: omi_record_seal_runs
description: Successful sweeper cycle count, including empty cycles.
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name="sweeper" AND jsonPayload.logger="record-seal-sweeper" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"event\": \"record_seal_sweep\"" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"outcome\": \"ok\""

name: omi_record_seal_nonempty_runs
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name="sweeper" AND jsonPayload.logger="record-seal-sweeper" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"event\": \"record_seal_sweep\"" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"outcome\": \"ok\"" AND jsonPayload.message=~"\"backlog\": [1-9][0-9]*"

name: omi_record_seal_old_runs
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name="sweeper" AND jsonPayload.logger="record-seal-sweeper" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"event\": \"record_seal_sweep\"" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"outcome\": \"ok\"" AND jsonPayload.message=~"\"oldest_unsealed_over_four_hours\": true"
